studio.label: About
studio.story: The Tall Men is a creative marketing agency based in Cairo. We study the market from a higher point of view, understand what the audience cares about, and turn it into strategy, content, media and production that people notice.

figure.alt: A tall faceless man holding a laptop under his arm

points.text: We start with the audience and the market, not with the format. The idea comes from what people actually care about.
Film, design and content made with taste, so the work earns the next second of someone's time.
Every campaign is read honestly after launch. What worked is pushed further, what didn't is fixed.
